# Parameter reference

Every setting of `amgeo_sd`, with type, default, allowed values and how to set it. Back to the [README](../README.md) or the [usage guide](USAGE.md); the Python functions are in the [API reference](API.md); example folders: [`configs/`](../configs/README.md), [`examples/`](../examples/median_day_analysis/README.md), [`tests/`](../tests/README.md), [`tests/data/`](../tests/data/README.md), [`_bkp/`](../_bkp/README.md).

## How parameters are set

Precedence, lowest to highest: **built-in default < TOML file < command-line flag / `make` variable**. Unknown keys and values outside the allowed range are errors, so a typo cannot silently fall back to a default.

| Way | Example |
|---|---|
| TOML file | `make median CONFIG=configs/median_bks_demo.toml` (see [`configs/default.toml`](../configs/default.toml), every key with a comment) |
| command line | `python -m amgeo_sd median -c cfg.toml --thresh 0.5 --no-kde` |
| `make` variable | `make median RAD=bks START=2025-02-08T03:00 END=2025-02-08T04:00 INPUT=tests/data/bks_20250208 THRESH=0.5` |
| check what will run | `make config-show CONFIG=cfg.toml THRESH=0.5` (or `python -m amgeo_sd median --print-config ...`) |

Every run writes an annotated `params.toml` next to its outputs; it is itself a valid config (`make median CONFIG=<run>/params.toml` repeats the run).

## `[run]`

What to process and where results go. Used by `median`, `dbscan`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description | Command line | `make` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rad` | str | required | three-letter radar code, e.g. `bks`, `gbr`; required | three-letter radar code | `-r`, `--rad` | `RAD` |
| `start` | datetime | required | UT; TOML datetime or ISO string; required | UT; scans starting in [start, end] are written | `-s`, `--start` | `START` |
| `end` | datetime | required | UT, not before `start`; required | UT | `-e`, `--end` | `END` |
| `sim_id` | str | `"L100"` | any folder name | run id: results go to &lt;out&gt;/&lt;sim_id&gt;/&lt;rad&gt;/ | `-sid`, `--sim-id` | `SID` |
| `out` | str | `"data/outputs"` | directory (created); results in `<out>/<sim_id>/<rad>/` | output base directory | `-o`, `--out` | `OUT` |
| `jobs` | int | `1` | whole number >= 1; `median` only | worker processes for the filter | `-j`, `--jobs` | `JOBS` |

## `[input]`

Where the fitacf data come from. Used by `median`, `dbscan`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description | Command line | `make` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `paths` | list of str | `[]` | files or directories (searched recursively); empty = archive lookup | fitacf files or directories (fitacf 2.0/2.5/3.0, .bz2/.gz/plain); empty = use the archive | `-i`, `--input` | `INPUT` |
| `root` | str | `$AMGEO_SD_DATA` | directory laid out `<year>/<ftype>/<rad>/<YYYYMMDD>.*` | archive root laid out &lt;year&gt;/&lt;ftype&gt;/&lt;rad&gt;/; empty = $AMGEO_SD_DATA | `--root` | - |
| `ftype` | str | `"fitacf"` | `fitacf` or `fitacf3`; archive lookup only | "fitacf" or "fitacf3" (archive lookup only) | `--ftype` | - |

## `[median]`

Median-filter model parameters. Used by `median`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description | Command line | `make` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `thresh` | float | `0.6` | (0, 1] | min fraction of the 3x3x3 neighbour weight that must hold an echo (legacy default 0.7) | `-th`, `--thresh` | `THRESH` |
| `pth` | float | `0.25` | (0, 1) | Beta-distribution cut for the KDE ground-scatter flag | `-pth`, `--pth` | `PTH` |
| `lth` | float | `0.2` | 0 <= lth < uth <= 1 | P(ground) &lt;= lth  -&gt; ionospheric (0) | `-lth`, `--lth` | `LTH` |
| `uth` | float | `0.8` | 0 <= lth < uth <= 1 | P(ground) &gt;= uth  -&gt; ground (1); in between -&gt; undetermined (2) | `-uth`, `--uth` | `UTH` |
| `kde` | bool | `true` | `true` / `false` | compute gflg_kde (the slow Beta fit); false -&gt; NaN | `--kde`, `--no-kde` | - |
| `cluster` | bool | `true` | `true` / `false` | DBSCAN labels per scan -&gt; clabel | `--cluster`, `--no-cluster` | - |
| `eps` | float | `2.0` | > 0, in (beam, gate) units | DBSCAN radius in (beam, gate) units | `--eps` | - |
| `min_samples` | int | `5` | whole number >= 1 | DBSCAN core-point size | `-ms`, `--min-samples` | - |
| `edge_gates` | str | `"legacy"` | `legacy` or `missing` | "legacy" = gates outside the radar range count as empty neighbours; "missing" = not counted | `--edge-gates` | - |

## `[dbscan]`

DBSCAN / Gaussian-mixture clustering model parameters. Used by `dbscan`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description | Command line | `make` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `eps` | float | `2.0` | > 0, in scaled (gate, scan) units | DBSCAN radius in (gate / eps_g, scan / eps_s) units | `-eps`, `--eps` | - |
| `eps_g` | float | `1.0` | > 0 | range-gate scale | `-eps_g`, `--eps-g` | - |
| `eps_s` | float | `1.0` | > 0 | scan-number scale | `-eps_s`, `--eps-s` | - |
| `min_samples` | int | `8` | whole number >= 1 | DBSCAN core-point size | `-ms`, `--min-samples` | - |
| `tb_mult` | int | `10` | whole number >= 1 | min_samples multiplier on the themis special beam | `-tm`, `--tb-mult` | - |
| `velocity_threshold` | float | `25.0` | m/s, > 0 | m/s; Ribiero rule: echoes faster than this count as high-velocity | `-vth`, `--velocity-threshold` | - |
| `min_gate` | int | `7` | range gate number >= 0 | echoes in gates below this stay unclassified (-1) | `--min-gate` | - |
| `gmm` | str | `""` | `""`, `"A"`, `"T"` or a beam list such as `"3,7"` | Gaussian-mixture step: "" none, "A" all beams, "T" themis beam, "3,7" listed beams | `-gmm`, `--gmm` | `GMM` |
| `n_clusters` | int | `5` | whole number >= 1 | mixture components | `-nc`, `--n-clusters` | - |
| `cov` | str | `"full"` | `full`, `tied`, `diag`, `spherical` | mixture covariance type: full, tied, diag or spherical | `-cov`, `--cov` | - |
| `n_data_th` | int | `100` | whole number >= 1 | beams with fewer echoes skip the mixture | `-gth`, `--n-data-th` | - |

## `[geometry]`

Range-cell geolocation (NetCDF gdlat/gdlon/gdazm and the maps). Used by `median`, `dbscan`, `plot fov`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description | Command line | `make` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `backend` | str | `"legacy"` | `legacy` or `pydarn` | "legacy" = original CalcFov (reproduces old results); "pydarn" = pydarn 4 (fixed cell height) | `--geometry` | `GEOMETRY` |
| `altitude` | float | `300.0` | km, in (0, 2000) | cell altitude in km | `--altitude` | - |

## `[output]`

Which products to write. Used by `median`, `dbscan`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description | Command line | `make` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `netcdf` | bool | `true` | `true` / `false`; at least one output must be on | &lt;rad&gt;_&lt;start&gt;_&lt;end&gt;.pp.nc | `--netcdf`, `--no-netcdf` | - |
| `fitacf` | bool | `true` | `true` / `false`; at least one output must be on | &lt;YYYYMMDD.HHMM.SS&gt;.&lt;rad&gt;.fitacf.pp.bz2 (bz2 DMAP, fitacf-compatible) | `--fitacf`, `--no-fitacf` | - |
| `extra_fields` | bool | `false` | `true` / `false` (default `false`) | also store non-standard fields (v_mad, gflg_conv, gflg_kde, clabel, cluster_tag, gflg_ribiero, amgeo.*) in the .fitacf.pp.bz2; false keeps it readable by pydarnio.read_fitacf and other fitacf tools (the .pp.nc always has them) | `--extra-fields`, `--no-extra-fields` | - |

## `[plot]`

Figures from fitacf or fitacf++ data. Used by `plot rti`, `plot fov`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description | Command line | `make` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inputs` | list of str | `[]` | files or directories of one kind (all `.nc` or all fitacf-type files) | fitacf / fitacf++ files or directories (.nc, .fitacf.pp.bz2, .fitacf[.bz2\|.gz]) | `-i`, `--input` | `INPUT` |
| `compare` | list of str | `[]` | same kinds as `inputs`; RTI only | RTI: more inputs stacked below the first one | `--compare` | `COMPARE` |
| `rad` | str | from the files | three-letter radar code | radar code; empty = from the files | `-r`, `--rad` | `RAD` |
| `beam` | int | `0` | beam number | RTI beam number | `-b`, `--beam` | `BEAM` |
| `start` | datetime | all data | UT | UT, only data from here (optional) | `-s`, `--start` | `START` |
| `end` | datetime | all data | UT | UT, only data up to here (optional) | `-e`, `--end` | `END` |
| `time` | datetime | first scan | UT; FoV only | UT, FoV map of the scan nearest to this time | `-t`, `--time` | `TIME` |
| `params` | list of str | `["v", "w_l", "p_l", "gflg"]` | `v w_l p_l v_mad`, flags `gflg gflg_conv gflg_kde gflg_ribiero`, `cluster_tag` | RTI panels / FoV maps: v w_l p_l v_mad, flags gflg gflg_conv gflg_kde gflg_ribiero, cluster_tag | `-p`, `--params` | `PARAMS` |
| `flag` | str | `"gflg"` | a flag column or `""`; RTI compare only | RTI compare: classification panel for each dataset; empty = none | `--flag` | - |
| `coords` | str | `"geo"` | `geo` or `aacgmv2`; FoV only | "geo" or "aacgmv2" | `--coords` | `COORDS` |
| `projection` | str | `"auto"` | `auto`, `polar`, `ortho`; FoV only | "auto", "polar" or "ortho" | `--projection` | - |
| `max_gate` | int | `0` | whole number; FoV only | FoV: number of gates drawn; 0 = all in the data | `--max-gate` | - |
| `terminator` | bool | `false` | `true` / `false`; geo coordinates only | FoV: shade the night side (geo coordinates only) | `--terminator`, `--no-terminator` | - |
| `out` | str | `"data/figures"` | directory (created) | output directory | `-o`, `--out` | `FIGDIR` |
| `name` | str | `""` | file name without extension | file name without extension; empty = generated from radar, time and parameters | `--name` | - |
| `format` | str | `"png"` | `png`, `pdf`, `svg` | png, pdf or svg | `--format` | - |
| `dpi` | int | `150` | whole number | resolution of raster output | `--dpi` | - |

## `make` variables

Variables are given on the command line (`make median RAD=bks ...`); an empty variable is not passed on, so the TOML file or the default applies.

| Variable | Meaning | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| `CONDA_ENV` | conda environment every command runs in (default `amgeo`) | all |
| `CONFIG` | TOML parameter file passed as `-c` | `median`, `dbscan`, `plot-rti`, `plot-fov`, `config-show` |
| `RAD` | radar code | `median`, `dbscan`, `plot-*`, `analyse-day` |
| `START` | start time `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM` (UT) | `median`, `dbscan`, `plot-*` |
| `END` | end time (UT) | `median`, `dbscan`, `plot-*` |
| `INPUT` | input files or directories (`-i`); for `plot-*` the data to plot | `median`, `dbscan`, `plot-*`, `analyse-day` |
| `OUT` | output base directory (`-o`) | `median`, `dbscan`, `out-clean` |
| `SID` | run id (`-sid`) | `median`, `dbscan` |
| `JOBS` | worker processes (`-j`) | `median` |
| `THRESH` | median threshold (`-th`) | `median` |
| `PTH` | Beta cut (`-pth`) | `median` |
| `LTH` | lower probability bound (`-lth`) | `median` |
| `UTH` | upper probability bound (`-uth`) | `median` |
| `GMM` | Gaussian-mixture beams (`-gmm`) | `dbscan` |
| `GEOMETRY` | `legacy` or `pydarn` (`--geometry`) | `median`, `dbscan`, `plot-*` |
| `EXTRA` | any further command-line flags, e.g. `EXTRA="--no-kde --edge-gates missing"` | `median`, `dbscan`, `plot-*`, `config-show` |
| `COMPARE` | second dataset stacked in the RTI (`--compare`) | `plot-rti` |
| `BEAM` | beam number (`-b`); for `analyse-day` the beam of the figures | `plot-rti`, `analyse-day` |
| `TIME` | FoV time (`-t`) | `plot-fov` |
| `PARAMS` | plotted parameters (`-p`) | `plot-rti`, `plot-fov` |
| `COORDS` | `geo` or `aacgmv2` (`--coords`) | `plot-fov` |
| `FIGDIR` | figure directory (`-o`) | `plot-rti`, `plot-fov` |
| `DAY` | UT day analysed, default `2025-02-08` | `analyse-day` |
| `WORK` | analysis working directory, default `data/analysis` | `analyse-day` |
| `DATA` | radar-day folders summarised, default all of `tests/data/*/` | `data-info`, `data-clean` |

## Output files

| File | Written by | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `<rad>_<start>_<end>.pp.nc` | `median`, `dbscan` | fitacf++ NetCDF4 (`[output] netcdf`); `<start>`/`<end>` as `YYYYMMDDHHMM` |
| `<YYYYMMDD.HHMM.SS>.<rad>.fitacf.pp.bz2` | `median`, `dbscan` | fitacf++ as bz2 DMAP (`[output] fitacf`); time = `start`; standard fitacf fields only unless `[output] extra_fields = true` (see [the extra fields](USAGE.md#the-extra-fields)) |
| `params.toml` | `median`, `dbscan` | all parameters, annotated, plus `[provenance]` and `[result]`; valid as `--config` |
| `script.cmd` | `median`, `dbscan` | the command line |
| `<name>.png` / `.pdf` / `.svg` | `plot` | default name `rti_<rad>_b<beam>_<date>_<time>_<params>` or `fov_<rad>_<date>_<time>_<params>_<coords>` |

Results go to `<out>/<sim_id>/<rad>/`. The meaning of the variables inside the files is in the [usage guide](USAGE.md).

## Plot parameter names

| Name | Kind | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `v`, `w_l`, `p_l` | numeric | line-of-sight velocity [m/s], spectral width [m/s], power [dB] |
| `v_mad` | numeric | median filter output: local spread of the velocity [m/s] |
| `gflg` | flag | fitacf flag for raw data; for the median model the legacy v-w rule (not recommended) |
| `gflg_conv`, `gflg_kde` | flag | median model; recommended |
| `gflg_ribiero` | flag | DBSCAN model: -1 unclassified, 0 ionospheric, 1 ground |
| `cluster_tag` | categorical | DBSCAN model cluster label, unique within a beam only |
